primitives.note: Deconstruction stacks (up to 3, 7s duration, refreshed by attacks/abilities) applied by every ability and on-hit attack; the 3rd stack consumes all stacks for a bonus true-damage burst
R's beam deals true damage instead of magic damage against a target that is 'Researched' (has/reached 3 Deconstruction stacks)

Q auto-recasts to split into two perpendicular bolts; W has two separately-timed damage instances (initial rift opening + later collapse); R can be manually recast to end the channel early, otherwise ends automatically at max duration
R is a 0.2s-delay then up to 2.6s channel that can be steered and blocks other actions while active
R ticks damage every 0.2s for the duration of the channel

W stocks up to 2 independent charges, each costing its own mana; the ddragon/wiki 'static' field of 1.5s is the minimum time between casts while the wiki's 19-to-15s 'recharge' governs regaining a spent charge
E is a location-targeted burst with a cast-distance-dependent delay before it lands, on a flat cooldown
Mana costs (40-70 per Q/W/E cast, 100 for R) meaningfully cap how many casts, especially cheap-cooldown W, fit into a 15s fight

needsBespoke.why: Vel'Koz's mechanics -- Deconstruction stacking into a consumed true-damage burst, Q's automatic split recast, W's dual damage instances plus 2-charge stock system, and R's channelled DoT with a Researched-true-damage conditional switch -- are all expressible with existing primitives (target-stacks, recast-or-multipart, weapon-or-ammo-system, charge-or-channel, dot, conditional-damage, plain-cast, resource-budget). No bespoke logic is required.

unsettled.question: Against a single stationary dummy, can Vel'Koz's manual/automatic Q recast (the split into two perpendicular bolts) ever land a second damage instance on the same target, or does the 'an enemy cannot be hit by multiple bolts' restriction prevent any double-hit from one Q cast regardless of split timing?
options: The split bolts can never hit a target already struck by the primary bolt from the same cast, so each Q cast deals exactly one damage instance against a single dummy
If the recast is triggered manually before the primary bolt reaches the target, a split bolt could still reach and hit the same dummy, yielding a second damage instance per cast
quotes: An enemy cannot be hit by multiple bolts even when having blocked one with a {{tip|spell shield}}.
''Plasma Fission'' can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range.

unsettled.question: W's numbers sheet lists a flat cooldown of 1.5s at every rank (also shown on the wiki template as 'static = {{fd|1.5}}'), but the wiki template also lists a separate 'recharge' of 19 to 15s (by rank) to regenerate a spent stocked charge, with a max of 2 charges banked. Which value should the simulator use to determine how many W casts land in the 15s fight?
options: Start with 2 charges banked, cast both back-to-back (1.5s apart, per the 'static' field), then wait the full recharge (~15-19s) before a 3rd cast is available -- W is effectively cast twice in a 15s fight
Treat the 1.5s 'static' value as W's real cooldown and ignore the charge-recharge mechanic, allowing near-continuous W casts limited only by mana
Treat the recharge value (15-19s) as the effective steady-state cooldown per charge, so at most 2-3 casts occur total
quotes: '''Vel'Koz''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Void Rift'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

unsettled.question: R applies a Deconstruction stack every 0.7s during its own channel. If this pushes the target to 3 stacks (Researched) partway through the channel, do the remaining ticks of that same R cast switch to true damage, or does the true-damage bonus only apply if the target was already Researched before R began channeling?
options: The switch to true damage is checked per-tick, so ticks after the target reaches Researched status mid-channel deal true damage even if earlier ticks in the same cast dealt magic damage

The damage type for the whole R cast is locked in at channel start based on whether the target was already Researched, so a target that only reaches Researched status via R's own stacking still takes magic damage for that entire cast
quotes: Applying 3 {{ai|Organic Deconstruction|Vel'Koz|''Deconstruction''}} stacks to an enemy {{tip|champion}} marks them as ''Researched'' for 7 seconds
The beam deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit every {{fd|0.2}} seconds... {{ai|Researched|Vel'Koz|''Researched''}} enemies take {{as|true damage}} instead.

proposal: Open with E on the dummy (applies the first Deconstruction stack and deals its upfront damage after the cast-distance-dependent delay).
Follow immediately with Q (the primary bolt hits for a second Deconstruction stack and its damage); do not rely on the split recast landing extra damage against a single stationary target.

Cast W using both available charges back-to-back (each application's initial+collapse damage lands and applies stacks); the second W's hit should push the target to 3 Deconstruction stacks, triggering Organic Deconstruction's bonus true-damage burst.
Weave basic attacks into any gap between ability casts to keep refreshing Deconstruction stacks and add on-hit damage.

Cast R once available and channel it for its full duration on the dummy, steering to keep it centered; once the target is Researched (3 stacks), R's remaining ticks (and any it re-applies) deal true damage.

After R ends, resume Q -> E -> W on cooldown (respecting W's limited charge recharge and everyone's mana costs) to keep re-triggering the Deconstruction true-damage burst and Researched status for the rest of the 15s window.
Given R's 80-100s cooldown, expect only a single R cast within the 15s fight; sequence the rest of the kit around it rather than around repeated R casts.
questions: Should R be cast as early as possible to front-load its long cooldown even though the target may not yet be Researched (so part of the channel deals magic, not true, damage), or should the rotation delay R until 3 Deconstruction stacks are already up so more of the channel deals true damage?
Does the simulator assume Vel'Koz starts the 15s fight with R already off cooldown, or must its long cooldown be respected from a fresh fight start (making it usable at most once)?

Should W's two charges be spent immediately at the start of the fight for a fast Researched trigger, or held/staggered to keep a charge banked for later re-triggering of Organic Deconstruction's true-damage burst?
